title: Identifying the players in the Ory band picture and its tonk style
summary: Joseph names Foster on bass, Stone on guitar and Chiff's brother, and says the Ory band played blues and tonk music while Holmes's reading men played differently.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: I wonder if you have time to go over this other Ori picture for a minute to tell who uh how many of the fellows there you remember. By the way where did you uh maybe I can tune this up while you're talking about that.
Before I forget it where did you get that picture and how long have you had it?
This name is Foster. That's his name. The bass player. Foster. That's the bass player. Is that just. It's a stone on the guitar player. Mmhmm. Stone on the guitar player.
Well Foster and Stone related or. No. No they're not related. No. No.

Chiff. That's Chiff's brother. Chiff is a cornet player. On the guitar player that's his brother. Mmhmm. That's Ori. Mmhmm. I can't call the drummer name. Or the violin. The violin I can't call his name. I can. I can find out. I can find out. Yeah. Well who is the clarinet player in that band? Did they ever have one? I see there's not one in the picture.
They don't have no clarinet band. Mmhmm. Would they ever use a piano with a band like that? Wasn't used no piano in them time.

Did Holmes ever have a piano? No piano. That's right. Mmhmm. Guitar, bass and drum. Well what would you describe that band as? What style did they? From St. John's. Same style. Did they read that band? Oh no. Many of them. I believe the violin player was the only man that read in that band. Mmhmm. Did they play more of a tunk music? Oh yeah. A lot of blues. Mmhmm.
Sure. Well would you say that they were more of a tunk band than Holmes' band? Did they play more ragtime than Holmes?

They had to. Cause Holmes, all his men used to read music pretty much, you know? Mmhmm. That makes them play more tunk, you know? Yeah, I see. I got the picture. Yeah. The difference between the two bands. Yeah. I was curious. It's a real musician in the Orleans. Mmhmm. Musicians. With Holmes. Mmhmm. All musicians.

You know where that picture was taken? Was that up in the country or down here in New Orleans? Down here in New Orleans. It was taken here you think? In the city. Taken here in New Orleans, yeah. I wonder what they were doing down here.
What they were doing? They used to come down here and play parades sometimes. Mmhmm. That carnival, you know? Big parade.
